settings.content: This logo applies across your Desktop Header, Mobile Header, Drawer Menu, Footer, and Password Page. Note: Shopify Checkout & Hosted Customer Login pages pull their logo from Shopify Admin > Settings > Brand. To sync everything seamlessly with 1 click, enable 'Use Shopify Brand Logo' below or upload the logo in Admin > Settings > Brand.

settings.label: Use Shopify Brand Logo (from Admin > Settings > Brand)
settings.info: When enabled, the theme prioritizes your primary brand logo from Shopify Admin > Settings > Brand, ensuring Header, Footer, Password Page, Checkout, and Customer Accounts match 100%.

settings.info: When disabled, hover states appear instantly without transitions or shadows.

settings.label: Button hover speed
settings.info: How long the colour fill takes on buttons. Higher = slower and softer. Needs "Enable hover transitions & button animations" turned on.

settings.label: Sliding fill animation on hover
settings.info: Off: the hover colour fades in smoothly. On: it slides in from the left. Applies to buttons, not to the variant/size option buttons.

settings.label: Enable subtle smooth scroll
settings.info: Adds gentle momentum easing to page scrolling across the store.

settings.label: Scroll smoothness level
settings.info: 1–2 = ultra-crisp, 3–4 = subtle luxury glide (recommended), 7–10 = deeper deceleration.
